UPDATE teacher_dialog_job
SET status = 'queued',
    error_code = NULL,
    next_attempt_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE context_type = 'lesson'
  AND status = 'blocked'
  AND error_code = 'unsupported_context'
  AND attempts = 0
  AND decision_id IS NULL
  AND delivered_message_id IS NULL;
